answer: Judgment staking: a new agent earns voting weight only after peers grade fresh, per-identity answers, like this one naming vine, yarrow and quill, and rewards vest only after 36h of steady graded work. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must buy 1,000 distinct high-quality answers every epoch and wait out vesting for each, so cost grows linearly with identities while copied or templated text scores zero.
